block.description: Define the CoreXY work-area boundaries by double-probing X min/max first, returning to X=0, then double-probing Y min/max at X=0.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board that should run the XY calibration routine.

inputs.label: X Track Length (cm)
inputs.description: CoreXY X workspace length in cm. Nominal robot length is 115 cm from the back-bottom-left origin.

inputs.label: Y Track Length (cm)
inputs.description: CoreXY Y workspace width in cm. Nominal robot width is 60 cm from the back-bottom-left origin.

inputs.label: Calibration Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Numeric motor speed used while probing limits.

inputs.label: Trapezoidal Speed
inputs.description: Enable acceleration and deceleration ramping instead of jumping directly to target speed.

inputs.label: Acceleration (RPM/s)
inputs.description: Acceleration and deceleration rate used for trapezoidal speed ramping.

advancedInputs.label: X Step Pin
advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the X axis driver.

advancedInputs.label: X Dir Pin
advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the X axis driver.

advancedInputs.label: Y Step Pin
advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the Y axis driver.

advancedInputs.label: Y Dir Pin
advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the Y axis driver.

advancedInputs.label: Motor A Step Multiplier
advancedInputs.description: Multiplier applied to CoreXY motor A step pulses. Use 2.0 when motor A needs twice as many step pulses as motor B for X-only motion.

advancedInputs.label: Limit Switch Layout
advancedInputs.description: Choose whether the XY gantry uses 2 shared/home switches or 4 end-stop switches.

advancedInputs.label: X Min Limit Pin
advancedInputs.description: GPIO pin for the X minimum/home limit switch.

advancedInputs.label: X Max Limit Pin
advancedInputs.description: GPIO pin for the X maximum limit switch.

advancedInputs.label: Y Min Limit Pin
advancedInputs.description: GPIO pin for the Y minimum/home limit switch.

advancedInputs.label: Y Max Limit Pin
advancedInputs.description: GPIO pin for the Y maximum limit switch.

firmwareRequirements.protocol: Serial commands: SET XY PINS <coreAStep> <coreADir> <coreBStep> <coreBDir> <motorAStepMultiplier>, SET XY LIMITS, CALIBRATE XY <xCm> <yCm> <speedRpm> <trapezoidFlag> <accelerationRpmPerSecond>. Firmware probes X min/max, then Y min/max at X=0, with a fast touch followed by a slow touch.

block.description: Move the CoreXY gantry to an absolute X/Y/Z position inside the 115 x 60 x 60 cm workspace. Origin 0,0,0 is the back-bottom-left corner.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Controller resolved from the Hardware Map for the CoreXY gantry routine.

inputs.label: X Position (cm)
inputs.description: Target X position in cm from the back-bottom-left origin. Range: 0 to 115 cm.

inputs.label: Y Position (cm)
inputs.description: Target Y position in cm from the back-bottom-left origin. Range: 0 to 60 cm.

inputs.label: Z Position (cm)
inputs.description: Target Z position in cm from the back-bottom-left origin. Range: 0 to 60 cm.

inputs.label: Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Numeric target motor speed for the move.

inputs.label: Trapezoidal Speed
inputs.description: Enable acceleration and deceleration ramping instead of jumping directly to target speed.

inputs.label: Acceleration (RPM/s)
inputs.description: Acceleration and deceleration rate used for trapezoidal speed ramping.

inputs.label: On-the-fly Calibration
inputs.description: When enabled, moves that end within 3 cm of a limit switch probe that switch and compare the observed position against calibration.

inputs.label: Max Calibration Difference (steps)
inputs.description: Maximum allowed on-the-fly limit-switch position error before a full recalibration is triggered.
